module: Zone marker without visual: makes a POI interactive when the player's vehicle (the four ground corners of its bounding box) is entirely inside one of the given zone polygons. No icon or decal is drawn. The module returns {create, cluster}; each zoneMarker POI forms its own cluster.
notes: cluster: one per POI (id 'zoneMarker#<poi.id>'). Reads poi.markerInfo.zoneMarker.{zones, pos, radius}; elemData = {poi.data}.

interactInPlayMode does nothing if the player is walking (interactData.isWalking). The vehicle's 2D distance to the center must be <= radius + 2 m, then points 1, 4, 5 and 8 of bbPoints (bottom or top corners of the box, inferred from code) must all be in a zone (containsPoint2D).
The 'inside' result is evaluated even without canInteract; adding to the interactive elements requires canInteract.
All the other methods (update, hide, show, createObjects, clearObjects, setHidden, instantFade) are empty.

create.desc: Builds a zone marker (instance of C).

cluster.desc: Turns each zoneMarker POI into a distinct cluster (no merging) and adds it to allClusters.

allClusters.desc: List of clusters completed in place.

setup.desc: Stores zones, cluster, 2D center (visibilityPos with z = 0) and radius (visibilityRadius).

interactInPlayMode.desc: Adds the cluster's data (elemData) to the interactive elements if the vehicle is entirely in a zone and canInteract is true; no effect on foot.

interactData.desc: Frame data: isWalking, vehPos2d, bbPoints, canInteract.
